breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the user provided the temperature differences for a parallel-flow heat exchanger (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out) despite requesting a counterflow configuration. The agent corrected this by specifying the proper counterflow temperature differences: ΔT1 = Th,in − Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out − Tc,in, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
